propositions: A single pending entry in the queue disables the O(1) fast path for the entire store, forcing a full O(n) directory walk on every subsequent write until the pending set empties.

The gate marker should be generalized to record a 'live' set of ticket IDs with active queue entries, allowing scoped O(backlog) reductions instead of O(store) full walks when a non-empty pending set exists.
Scoped marker probes must not rewrite the marker or refresh its TTL, preserving the TTL bound measured from the last full walk and preventing stale marker refresh races.
New-enqueued entries must remain visible and not hidden behind the marker's live set, ensured by clearing the marker on every append.
The marker's honesty contract must be preserved: it only asserts absence of pending work (whole-store or outside live-set); pending verdicts derive solely from reducing real queue events.
